entries.question: What are the six runtime ports in finstack-ai?
entries.scripted_response: The six runtime ports are model, tool, context, middleware, observer, and journal (see the architecture self-doc).

entries.question: How do sessions and lanes relate?
entries.scripted_response: A session is a durable conversation; lanes are its independent ordered histories, with main as the default lane (sessions self-doc).

entries.question: Which document formats can I ingest?
entries.scripted_response: Ingestion converts pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, odf, rtf, epub, and csv documents to Markdown via the document toolset (ingestion self-doc).

entries.question: What happens when I ingest a scanned PDF?
entries.scripted_response: A scanned PDF parses successfully with requires_ocr set to true; OCR itself is not enabled, so the agent tells you the text is not extractable.

entries.question: How does the agent remember facts across sessions?
entries.scripted_response: The memory extension stores facts durably and recalls them through a context provider before each turn; recall is keyword ranked (memory self-doc).

entries.question: How should answers cite their sources?
entries.scripted_response: Answers name the source document or memory record for each claim, per the citations skill in the capability catalog.

entries.question: Can Python open a CLI-created session?
entries.scripted_response: Yes: the CLI and Python notebooks share one sqlite journal, so either surface can open sessions the other created.

entries.question: Can the agent browse the web?
entries.scripted_response: Network fetch is deny-by-default: the fetch toolset is only registered when an explicit host allowlist is configured.

entries.question: What do all three surfaces have in common?
entries.scripted_response: Every surface consumes the same RunEventKind stream from the journal-backed runtime; the renderers differ, the events do not.

entries.question: What is the share price of Acme Corp?
entries.scripted_response: I do not know: nothing ingested or remembered covers Acme Corp share prices.

entries.question: Where do we keep the archived money totals?
entries.scripted_response: A remembered note says the quarterly revenue ledgers rest inside vault nine.

memory_seed.body: Quarterly revenue ledgers rest inside vault nine.
